emision.explicacion.texto: What you see on your phone, AR included, appears on the classroom computer for the projector or TV.

emision.solo_profes.texto: Teachers only: sign in with the same account as on the computer.

emision.crear_cuenta.texto: Create one in the teacher dashboard

emision.paso_ordenador.texto: On the classroom computer open {url} with your account.

emision.paso_movil.texto: Tap «Broadcast» and use the app as usual: it shows on the projector.

emision.sin_sesion.texto: Sign in as a teacher to broadcast.

emision.error_red.texto: No connection to the server. Retrying automatically.

emision.esperando_movil.texto: Waiting for a phone to broadcast…

emision.elige_movil.texto: Which phone do you want to show?

emision.proyector_paso1.texto: On your phone, open the app and go to your profile.

emision.proyector_paso2.texto: In «Project in class», sign in with this same teacher account.

emision.proyector_paso3.texto: Tap «Broadcast»: it will appear here by itself.

emision.aviso_mundo.texto: World AR: the phone cannot share its camera; only the 3D objects are shown.

emision.video_etiqueta.texto: What the teacher's phone is showing
